exposure: prophylactic temporary balloon occlusion of the infrarenal abdominal aorta
Prophylactic temporary balloon occlusion of the infrarenal abdominal aorta
outcome: Days in the intensive care unit
Incidence of thrombosis in lower limbs
cohort: 268 patients with placenta praevia accreta, with 230 receiving prophylactic temporary balloon occlusion of the infrarenal abdominal aorta and 38 undergoing caesarean section without endovascular intervention
finding: Prophylactic temporary balloon occlusion of the infrarenal abdominal aorta followed by caesarean section appears to be safe and effective in controlling intraoperative blood loss and decreasing the risk of hysterectomy in patients with placenta praevia accreta.
